steps.name: Provence
steps.text: Yeah, that's how we met Ceylon in the forest at the base of the volcano.

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: I have a question.

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: Did you really have to give an entire dissertation on how you saved me?

steps.name: Skyfire
steps.text: I'm with the lassie here. Plus, did I hear you say something about how you found me annoying?

steps.name: Provence
steps.text: Ah, um, you must have heard me wrong!

options: Regardless, what's important is that everyone is safe.

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: Umm, well, even though it's rather late for this, allow me to introduce myself.

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: My name is Ceylon Doykos, and I'm a graduate of Victoria National University as well an Originium researcher. I'm also the daughter of this city's mayor.

steps.name: Skyfire
steps.text: Who would've expected the mayor's daughter to be wandering around alone on the volcano?

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: Well, academic curiosity necessarily comes with its share of dangers...

steps.name: Provence
steps.text: Let's continue talking about that volcano...

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: A-ahem.

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: Thank you very much, strangers.

steps.name: Provence
steps.text: Don't mention it.

steps.name: Provence
steps.text: But, what brings you here alone?

steps.name: Provence
steps.text: Isn't this a bit too far for a long walk on the beach?

steps.name: Provence
steps.text: Hmm, judging by the tools you have on you...

steps.name: Skyfire
steps.text: Provence, she's here to investigate, just like us.

steps.name: Provence
steps.text: Huh, is that so?

steps.name: Skyfire
steps.text: She has a notebook with her, but she's also dressed to the nines.

steps.name: Skyfire
steps.text: Assuming she's not just a simpleton, then that means...

steps.name: Skyfire
steps.text: She had a flash of inspiration and rushed out of the house without even bothering to change, and then ran into trouble while still dressed like this.

steps.name: Skyfire
steps.text: I can't begin to tell you how many dresses I've gotten burnt this way.

steps.name: Provence
steps.text: Uhh, don't you think that's just a little abnormal?

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: Well, setting aside the thing with the dresses, you've pretty much got the gist of it.

steps.name: Provence
steps.text: I do have to say, it's rather dangerous to do that... especially if you're not prepared.

steps.name: Skyfire
steps.text: Don't worry. As long as I'm here, you could even come empty-handed and still be fine.

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: Anyways, thanks for saving me.

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: Come find me after I get back to town, and I'll be sure to repay you.

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: However, I have something important to do right now, so pardon me for my rudeness.

steps.name: Provence
steps.text: Oh, if you're still busy, then sorry for interrupting. However, it's best not to go to the volcano alone.

steps.name: Provence
steps.text: You should know how dangerous it is by yourself since you got attacked by these Originium slugs.

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: Well, that was just an accident. I was in a a hurry, so I wasn't paying attention to my surroundings.

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: I grew up in this city. If the Originium slugs really are that dangerous, the mayor would've done something about it.

steps.name: Provence
steps.text: ...Hmm, all right. However, if you ask me, I'd say they gathered here for a reason.

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: Nothing's different about this place, so why would...

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: Wait, agitation due to changes in the environment.... So that's what's going on! Thank you, I have another line of evidence!

steps.name: Skyfire
steps.text: ...Provence, by the looks of things, she reached the same conclusion as you.

steps.name: Skyfire
steps.text: Even though I'm not an expert on volcanoes, I do have a degree of understanding as a professional and comprehensive scholar.

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: Could you two also be here to look for proof?

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: Proof that the volcano is going to erupt?

steps.name: Provence
steps.text: An unusual and irritating odor, a higher temperature than normal, and aggressive Originium slugs...

steps.name: Provence
steps.text: Also, based on the presence of these infected creatures, this may be no ordinary volcano. The mining companies would go crazy if they found out that there might be Originium in this volcano.

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: Not many people know about the actual conditions of the volcano, and information about it is controlled by the City Council's relevant departments.

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: Agitation due to environmental changes... At least that gives me something to work with.

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: I've been looking for experts in this field to help ensure the safety of the city and its residents.

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: Please help me, and the city of Siesta, make it through these dangerous times.
